Container.Name: ASA-Server
Container.Overview:
ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated server with multi-map cluster support.
IMPORTANT PORT SETUP:
Before applying this template, click:
"Add another Path, Port, Variable, Label or Device"
Add the following two port mappings:
Game Port: Type: Port Connection Type: UDP Host Port: Must match the Game Port value Container Port: Must match the Game Port value
RCON Port: Type: Port Connection Type: TCP Host Port: Must match the RCON Port value Container Port: Must match the RCON Port value
The host port, container port, and corresponding environment-variable value must use the same port number.
Example first map: Game Port variable: 7777 UDP host 7777 -> container 7777
RCON Port variable: 27020 TCP host 27020 -> container 27020
Example second map: Game Port variable: 7778 UDP host 7778 -> container 7778
RCON Port variable: 27021 TCP host 27021 -> container 27021
Every map container must use unique game and RCON ports.
Each container uses one private instance-data directory containing the ASA installation, configuration, saves, logs, Steam metadata, and Proton prefix.
Multiple map containers can share one cluster directory by using the same Cluster ID and Shared Cluster Directory host path.
Master INI files are stored under /data/config and copied into ASA's WindowsServer configuration directory each time the container starts. Missing INI files are generated automatically during the first startup.

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: Private data for this map, the ASA installation, configuration, saves, logs, and Proton prefix. Every map container must use a different host directory.

Config.Name: Shared Cluster Directory
Config.Description: Shared player, item, and creature transfer data. Every map in the same cluster must use this exact same host directory.

Config.Name: Session Name
Config.Description: Public server name displayed in the ARK server browser.

Config.Name: Map Name
Config.Description: ASA map launch name. The requested map must be included in the installed ASA server version. Example: TheIsland_WP.

Config.Name: Maximum Players
Config.Description: Maximum number of simultaneous players allowed on this server.

Config.Name: Mod IDs
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated ASA CurseForge mod project IDs in load order. Leave blank to run without mods. Example: 928708,929110,935408

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: UDP port used directly by ASA. Manually add a UDP port mapping where the host port and container port both match this value. Every map must use a unique game port.

Config.Name: RCON Port
Config.Description: TCP port used by ASA RCON and graceful shutdown. Manually add a TCP port mapping where the host port and container port both match this value. Every map must use a unique RCON port.

Config.Name: Cluster ID
Config.Description: Shared cluster identifier. Every map that should allow character, creature, and item transfers must use exactly the same value.

Config.Name: Server Admin Password
Config.Description: Administrator password passed to ASA and used for RCON authentication.

Config.Name: Player Server Password
Config.Description: Optional password players must enter to join. Leave blank for no player password.

Config.Name: Extra Server Arguments
Config.Description: Optional advanced command-line arguments passed directly to ArkAscendedServer.exe. Separate arguments with spaces. Do not place Game.ini or GameUserSettings.ini settings here.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Container time zone.

Config.Name: Update Server at Startup
Config.Description: When true, SteamCMD checks for and installs ASA server updates before starting the map. When false, the currently installed server files are used.

Config.Name: Validate Server Files
Config.Description: When true, SteamCMD verifies the complete ASA server installation before startup. Use for troubleshooting or repairing damaged server files because validation substantially increases startup time.

Config.Name: Enable BattlEye
Config.Description: Set to true to launch ASA with BattlEye. When false, the container adds the -NoBattlEye launch argument.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Creates persistent container, Proton, system-information, launch-information, and ASA diagnostic files under /data/logs/debug. Enable only while troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Debug Log Maximum Size
Config.Description: Maximum size in MB for each generated container or Proton debug log. Older content is removed while retaining the newest diagnostic information.

Config.Name: Post-Save Delay
Config.Description: Seconds to wait after sending the RCON SaveWorld command before requesting server shutdown. This gives ASA time to finish writing the save.

Config.Name: ASA Shutdown Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds the shutdown script waits for ASA to exit normally. Docker has a separate 210-second stop timeout and may forcibly terminate the container after that deadline.
